title: Bouts ending in a finish, by year
alt: Line chart: share of UFC bouts ending in a KO, TKO or submission, January to mid-September of each year. 52.5% in 2016, 49.0% in 2021, 45.0% in 2024, 49.3% in 2025, 55.6% in 2026.
footnote: Jan to 19 Sep of each year, same window every year. KO, TKO and submission. Source: First Light Observatory.
